skill_outcomes.skill_name: Basic concepts of natural resource economics
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and remember basic concepts of natural resource economics.
Understand and remember methods for efficient economic exploitation of natural resources.
Understand models of depletable resource extraction.
Understand the concept and characteristics of recycling resources and recycling markets.
Understand the concepts and characteristics of water resources and water resource economics.
Understand the concepts and characteristics of biological resources and biological resource economics.
Understand the concepts and characteristics of renewable energy and renewable energy economics.
Apply knowledge from the course to analyze natural resource economics.
Develop skills to discuss and explain analytical contents about natural resource economics.
Develop group work ability with the capacity to take responsibility.
